text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Good and evil... light and darkness... 
This world where opposing phenomena swirl 
together— is pure chaos itself!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Having emerged from such a world... what 
on earth are you, Vodka!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Uhhhh... chaos...? Ummmmm... m-my 
head's spinning...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed――you too are chaos!! A being born 
from chaos, bringing forth chaos!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, chaos is the crucible of all 
creation... A phenomenon unforeseen even 
by the gods...!! And that is precisely 
what you are, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, that's so baaadass!! Chaos!! 
I'm... Chaos!! That's super cool!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I shall... chronicle the history newly 
forged by Chaos, and pass it down to 
posterity as the Book of Chaos..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And eventually, the Book of Chaos shall 
become myth, laying the foundation for a 
brand new epic! Ah-hah-hah-hah!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai... You're... going to write about 
me...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Thank you so much! This is the best 
birthday present ever! I'm gonna become 
pure chaos!!
